effect.name: Multi-Scale Sharpen
effect.desc: Multi-band detail sharpening: extracts Tiny, Small, Medium, and Large frequency bands via difference-of-blurs and boosts each independently. A Sobel-based edge threshold suppresses halos on strong edges, luma and chroma are sharpened separately in YUV, per-channel RGB gains are available, and a luma or alpha matte can restrict the result. Best quality uses Gaussian kernels; Fast uses box blurs.
